sources.title: Taiwanese singer Chyi Yu to hold concert in KL on April 26 | The Star
sources.description:
Chyi Yu Promotional Portrait

Chyi Yu stands poised against a stark white background, wearing a deep burgundy velvet wrap top paired with a flowing gray skirt. Her dark hair is swept into an elegant updo, and a bold, multi-stone necklace frames her warm smile. 

The award-winning Taiwanese singer, famed for her 1979 hit "The Olive Tree," will return to Malaysia on April 26 for her Forever Splendor 2025 Live concert at Mega Star Arena in Kuala Lumpur. Fans can look forward to timeless classics like "Boat Song," "Smiling Face," and "Dream Land," with tickets available from January 13.

Qi Yu’s Timeless Presence

Qi Yu, born in Taichung in 1957, has long been celebrated for her ethereal voice and influential role in Mandarin pop music. After studying anthropology at National Taiwan University and UCLA, she launched a career marked by classics such as “Olive Tree” and award-winning film themes. Her performance of “Huan Yan” on the 2019 season of “Singer” secured her a strong second-place finish, reaffirming her status as a “hall of fame” vocalist.

sources.description:
Chyi Yu’s 1988 Album "有沒有這種說法"

Chyi Yu’s third Mandarin studio album, released in 1988, marked a bold departure from her previous folk-inspired image. The cover features a blue-hued portrait of the singer looking directly at the viewer, with the album title “有沒有這種說法” and her name in vertical yellow text.

Produced by her brother Chyi Chin under the newly formed Rainbow Music Studio, the album was arranged by 20-year-old Tu Hui-yuan, who combined MIDI soundscapes with a rock band setup. sources.title: 般若波羅蜜多心經 - song and lyrics by Chyi Yu | Spotify
sources.description:
Chyi Yu’s Meditative Album Cover

A serene portrait of Chyi Yu dressed entirely in white stands before a light backdrop, her gaze lowered and arms gently extended. Bold red Chinese text overlays the image, stating "因此更美麗" above her torso and identifying the artist "齊豫" with the album series "唱經給你聽之一 順心" below.

This artwork serves as the cover for Chyi Yu’s 2004 rendition of "般若波羅蜜多心經," available on Spotify. The minimalist design and soft color palette underscore the spiritual and calming essence of the Buddhist chant interpretation featured on the track.
